== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for the Boba Fett (Special Edition) family. One column per published text state, in date order: the First Anthology preview card, the Special Edition card, Decipher's Glossary errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark the words that changed between neighbouring columns; “–1”/“-1” and “&lt;3”/“&lt; 3” are the Glossary's typesetting, not a change. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.
